business_problem: The CA DMV needed to replace legacy, siloed licensing and service systems with an omnichannel platform that could handle identity services for tens of millions of residents while cutting wait times, manual paperwork, and repeated handoffs.
solution_summary: The California DMV modernized core citizen-service workflows on Salesforce Customer 360 for Public Sector using Experience Cloud, Public Sector Solutions, MuleSoft, Service Cloud, Scheduler, Shield, Tableau, and CRM Analytics. Its Digital eXperience Platform gives residents a portal and chatbot front door, while Service Cloud captures those interactions alongside CTI and IVR context to build a 360-degree resident profile. If automation cannot finish the request, workflow rules and Salesforce Scheduler move the citizen into a virtual field-office appointment, while the same platform supports intelligent document processing, decision automation, and a mobile driver's license workflow tied to the DMV system of record. Shield, Tableau, and CRM Analytics add governance and operational reporting so the DMV can reuse designs across programs and measure where automated workflows deflect work before staff intervene.
data_flow: Residents start through Experience Cloud and chat, CTI/IVR activity is written into Service Cloud profiles, MuleSoft moves data among DMV programs and document workflows, Scheduler escalates complex cases to virtual appointments, and Shield plus analytics layers monitor service performance and security across the platform.
business_outcome: The DMV shortened high-friction transactions, solved more calls through automation, and created a reusable digital-service architecture that supports new programs without repeating legacy modernization from scratch.
metrics: REAL ID application time dropped from 35 to 7 minutes
